name: artifact_list
description: List the files this session produced that are candidates for export, with their size, type, hash and inspection status. This reads the Host's registry; it does not browse the runtime's filesystem. A file is only downloadable once its status is SAFE, and artifact_export is what delivers it.

limit.description: How many artifacts to return in one page.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous call, to get the following page.
